why: B437: deleting a connection takes its whole wait. The machine withdraws its waiting card at the delete and clears its entries and its announced record; the Swift monitor cleared only the prompts it had posted and redrew the card from the entries left (posting a fresh card for the connection it deleted), left a pushed card it never posted up, and kept the record, so a script that tracks the same connection again had the card withdrawn only once a later poll re-adopted it. In the app a deleted connection's id never comes back.
